title: BMAD Guided Path Starters
description: Codex-native routing catalog for starting BMAD paths while preserving the intended CLI/editor workflow behavior.

paths.label: Not Sure Yet
paths.when: Use when the user wants BMAD but is unsure which path fits.
paths.firstQuestion: What outcome do you want BMAD to help you reach first: understand the project, shape an idea, plan work, design the solution, implement, review, or debug?

paths.label: Full Lifecycle
paths.when: Use for serious new product or feature work that should progress from concept through implementation.
paths.firstQuestion: What are we trying to build, who is it for, and what would make it worth building?

paths.label: Document Existing Project
paths.when: Use for brownfield projects where BMAD should understand the current codebase before planning changes.
paths.firstQuestion: Should I run an initial scan, a full rescan, or a focused deep dive, and are there specific folders or documents I should prioritize?

paths.label: Generate Project Context
paths.when: Use when an existing project needs a compact project-context.md for downstream agents.
paths.firstQuestion: What project areas, conventions, or implementation rules must downstream agents preserve?

paths.label: Brainstorm Project
paths.when: Use when the idea is still fluid or the user is stuck generating options.
paths.firstQuestion: What problem, audience, or constraint should the brainstorming session focus on?

paths.label: Market Research
paths.when: Use to validate customer, market, competitor, or trend assumptions.
paths.firstQuestion: What market question are we trying to answer, and what decision will this research support?

paths.label: Domain Research
paths.when: Use for industry, policy, operational, terminology, or subject-matter discovery.
paths.firstQuestion: What domain do we need to understand, and what decisions depend on that understanding?

paths.label: Technical Research
paths.when: Use to explore feasibility, architecture options, or implementation approaches before deciding.
paths.firstQuestion: What technical choice or feasibility question needs evidence before we commit?

paths.label: Create Product Brief
paths.when: Use when the concept is plausible and needs a clear strategic brief.
paths.firstQuestion: What product or feature are we shaping, and what is the strongest user-value claim we need to test?

paths.label: PRFAQ Challenge
paths.when: Use to stress-test a product concept through a working-backwards PRFAQ.
paths.firstQuestion: What launch claim should survive the PRFAQ gauntlet, and what would make it fail?

paths.label: Create PRD
paths.when: Use to create requirements through coached discovery.
paths.firstQuestion: What are we building, and what source material should the PRD discovery use?

paths.label: Update PRD
paths.when: Use when an existing PRD must be reconciled with a change signal.
paths.firstQuestion: Which PRD should be updated, and what change signal or new evidence should it absorb?

paths.label: Validate PRD
paths.when: Use to review a finished PRD against BMAD readiness criteria.
paths.firstQuestion: Which PRD should be validated, and what standard or risk lens matters most?

paths.label: Create UX
paths.when: Use when screens, journeys, service design, accessibility, or usability materially affect success.
paths.firstQuestion: Which users, journeys, or screens need design decisions before architecture or stories?

paths.label: Architecture
paths.when: Use when requirements exist and the project needs implementation boundaries, ADRs, and system decisions.
paths.firstQuestion: What requirements, UX artifacts, constraints, and existing system context should the architecture ratify?

paths.label: Create Epics and Stories
paths.when: Use when PRD and architecture are ready to break into implementable work.
paths.firstQuestion: Which PRD and architecture artifacts should drive the epic and story breakdown?

paths.label: Check Implementation Readiness
paths.when: Use before implementation to check alignment across PRD, UX, architecture, epics, and stories.
paths.firstQuestion: Which planning artifacts should be checked, and what risk would block implementation?

paths.label: Sprint Planning
paths.when: Use to initialize or refresh the sprint plan for implementation agents.
paths.firstQuestion: Which approved stories should enter the sprint plan, and what sequencing constraints matter?

paths.label: Sprint Status
paths.when: Use to summarize implementation status and route to the next story-cycle step.
paths.firstQuestion: Which sprint-status file should I read, and are we looking for next action, risks, or a summary?

paths.label: Create Story
paths.when: Use to prepare the next story from the sprint plan.
paths.firstQuestion: Should I select the next story from sprint status or prepare a specific epic/story?

paths.label: Validate Story
paths.when: Use to verify story readiness before development.
paths.firstQuestion: Which story should be validated before development begins?

paths.label: Develop Story
paths.when: Use to implement a prepared and validated story with tests.
paths.firstQuestion: Which validated story should be implemented, and what local validation command should prove it?

paths.label: Code Review
paths.when: Use after story implementation to review behavior, quality, and acceptance criteria.
paths.firstQuestion: Which story implementation or diff should be reviewed, and what acceptance criteria must be checked?

paths.label: QA Automation Tests
paths.when: Use to generate API or E2E tests for implemented behavior.
paths.firstQuestion: Which implemented behavior needs automated coverage, and what test environment is available?

paths.label: Checkpoint Preview
paths.when: Use for a guided human review of a branch, commit, PR, or checkpoint.
paths.firstQuestion: What change should be previewed, and what decision do you need from the review?

paths.label: Retrospective
paths.when: Use after an epic or meaningful work slice to capture lessons and next actions.
paths.firstQuestion: What work slice are we reviewing, and what outcome should the retrospective improve?

paths.label: Quick Dev
paths.when: Use for small bounded implementation where full lifecycle ceremony would slow the work down.
paths.firstQuestion: What exact change should be made, what files or behavior are in scope, and how should it be verified?

paths.label: Investigate
paths.when: Use for unclear bugs, incidents, regressions, contradictions, or forensic analysis.
paths.firstQuestion: What is the observed symptom, what changed recently, and what evidence do we already have?

paths.label: Correct Course
paths.when: Use when requirements, architecture, stories, or implementation have drifted.
paths.firstQuestion: What changed, which artifacts are affected, and should we repair, replan, or restart a path?

paths.label: Write Document
paths.when: Use for structured technical or product documentation.
paths.firstQuestion: What document should be written, who is the audience, and what source material should ground it?

paths.label: Generate Mermaid Diagram
paths.when: Use to create a Mermaid diagram from a description.
paths.firstQuestion: What should the diagram communicate, and do you prefer flowchart, sequence, state, class, ER, or timeline?

paths.label: Validate Document
paths.when: Use to review a document against documentation standards.
paths.firstQuestion: Which document should be validated, and what standard or audience should guide the review?

paths.label: Explain Concept
paths.when: Use for clear technical explanations with examples and diagrams.
paths.firstQuestion: What concept should be explained, and what background should I assume?

paths.label: Spec
paths.when: Use to distill mixed intent into a concise SPEC.md contract before implementation.
paths.firstQuestion: What input should be distilled into a spec, and what downstream work must the spec control?

paths.label: Party Mode
paths.when: Use when multiple BMAD perspectives would materially improve the decision.
paths.firstQuestion: What question should the BMAD agents discuss, and which perspectives do you want at the table?

paths.label: Customize BMAD
paths.when: Use to persist recurring preferences, agent behavior, templates, hooks, or project conventions.
paths.firstQuestion: What recurring preference or workflow behavior should BMAD remember or change?

paths.label: Index Docs
paths.when: Use when the agent needs to understand available docs without loading everything.
paths.firstQuestion: Which documentation folder or corpus should be indexed, and what question should the index support?

paths.label: Shard Document
paths.when: Use when a document is too large to manage effectively in one context.
paths.firstQuestion: Which document should be sharded, and what structure should the shards preserve?

paths.label: Editorial Review - Prose
paths.when: Use after drafting to polish clarity, style, and wording.
paths.firstQuestion: Which document should receive prose review, and what tone or audience should it target?

paths.label: Editorial Review - Structure
paths.when: Use when a document needs organization, flow, or multi-source structural improvement.
paths.firstQuestion: Which document needs structural review, and what outcome should the structure support?

paths.label: Adversarial Review
paths.when: Use for quality assurance before finalizing deliverables.
paths.firstQuestion: What deliverable should be reviewed, and what failure modes matter most?

paths.label: Edge Case Hunter Review
paths.when: Use to mechanically enumerate unhandled branching paths and boundary conditions.
paths.firstQuestion: What code, spec, or process should be traced for unhandled edge cases?
